CAS — 68377-92-4 (arotinolol); 68377-91-3 (arotinolol hydrochloride). (arotinolol) Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn. Profile Arotinolol is a non-cardioselective beta blocker (p.1225); it also has alpha1-blocking activity. It is used as the hydrochloride in the management of hypertension (p.1171), angina pectoris (p.1157), cardiac arrhythmias (p.1160), and essential tremor (p.1231). The usual oral dose is 20 mg daily in 2 divided doses although up to 30 mg daily may be given. The initial dose for essential tremor is 10 mg daily.
